requirements.quote: (vii) use proposal information obtained through site visits, management interviews and the Authority’s investigation of a proposer’s qualifications, experience, ability or financial standing, and any material or information submitted by the proposer in response to the agency’s request for clarifying information in the course of evaluation and/or selection under the RFP;
requirements.text: The Authority may use proposal information obtained through various means for evaluation.

requirements.quote: (viii) prior to the bid opening, amend the RFP specifications to correct errors or oversights, or to supply additional information, as it becomes available;
requirements.text: The Authority may amend the RFP specifications before the bid opening.

requirements.quote: (ix) prior to the bid opening, direct proposers to submit proposal modifications addressing subsequent RFP amendments;
requirements.text: Proposers may be directed to submit modifications addressing RFP amendments.

requirements.quote: (x) change any of the scheduled dates;
requirements.text: The Authority may change scheduled dates.

requirements.quote: (xi) eliminate any mandatory, non-material specifications that cannot be complied with by all of the prospective proposers;
requirements.text: The Authority may eliminate non-material specifications that cannot be met by all proposers.

requirements.quote: (xii) waive any requirements that are not material;
requirements.text: The Authority may waive non-material requirements.

requirements.quote: (xiii) negotiate with the successful proposer within the scope of the RFP in the best interests of the Authority;
requirements.text: The Authority may negotiate with the successful proposer within the RFP scope.

requirements.quote: (xiv) conduct contract negotiations with the next responsible proposer, should the Authority be unsuccessful in negotiating with the selected proposer;
requirements.text: The Authority may negotiate with the next proposer if negotiations fail with the selected one.

requirements.quote: (xv) utilize any and all ideas submitted in the proposals received;
requirements.text: The Authority may use ideas from received proposals.

requirements.quote: (xvi) unless otherwise specified in the solicitation, every submission is a firm offer and not revocable for a period of 60 days from the bid opening; and,
requirements.text: Submissions are firm offers not revocable for 60 days unless specified otherwise.

requirements.quote: (xvii) require clarification at any time during the procurement process and/or require correction of arithmetic or other apparent errors for the purpose of assuring a full and complete understanding of an offerer’s proposal and/or to determine an offerer’s compliance with the requirements of the solicitation.
requirements.text: The Authority may request clarifications or corrections during the procurement process.

requirements.quote: (xviii) waive or modify minor deviations in the proposals received after prior notification to the Proposers;
requirements.text: The Authority may waive or modify minor deviations in proposals after notifying proposers.

requirements.quote: (xix) request best and final offers; and
requirements.text: The Authority may request best and final offers.

requirements.quote: (xx) Should the Authority be unsuccessful in negotiating a contract with a selected Proposer, the Authority may begin contract negotiations with the next highest-rated qualified Proposer. In addition, if it is subsequently determined by the Authority that the selected Proposer is non-responsible, the Authority may then invite the next highest
requirements.text: The Authority may negotiate with the next proposer if the selected one is non-responsible.
